title: SanaCkoala
description:
[b]SanaCkoala[/b] sends a sleepy Koala and a hungry Panda up the Spire. One naps through every fight, the other eats through it. Both play fine solo, and they are at their best side by side in co-op. Someone else is waiting to be found, too.

[h2]The Koala: sleeps on the job[/h2]
70 HP. Starter relic: [b]Eucalyptus Leaf[/b] (start each combat with 3 Drowsy). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Eucalyptus Crown[/b] (6 Drowsy).
[list]
[*][b]Drowsy[/b]: at the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Drowsy. Napping counts as defending.
[*][b]Waking up[/b]: some cards remove all of your Drowsy at once for a big effect. Mornings hit hard.
[*]Three ways to play: never wake up (Hibernation Fortress), save Drowsy for one loud Alarm Burst, or keep a hand full of Dream and Retain cards.
[/list]

[h2]The Panda: will fight for snacks[/h2]
80 HP. Starter relic: [b]Bamboo Basket[/b] (start each combat with 3 Bamboo). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Bamboo Hamper[/b] (6 Bamboo).
[list]
[*][b]Bamboo[/b] is a resource you gather with cards and powers. It is also lunch.
[*][b]Munch N[/b]: if you have at least N Bamboo, the card eats it and does something extra.
[*][b]Full[/b]: your first Munch each turn gives one Full, which feeds the menu, belly and Roll cards.
[*]Four ways to play: order off the Full menu, turn Block into counterattacks, stack Strength for multi-hits, or build up Roll and let it go.
[/list]

[h2]???[/h2]
Something is waiting at the top of the Spire. Take the Koala and the Panda up there and see who shows up. And that may not be the last pair of paws.

Each character has 87 cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare and 2 Ancient), the same split as the vanilla characters. Each also has seven relics on top of the starter relic, and three potions.

[h2]Ancient cards and events[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Archaic Tooth[/b] turns Doze into Deep Sleep and Gather Bamboo into Bamboo Harvest.
[*][b]Dusty Tome[/b] gives the Koala Lazy Sunday and the Panda Rolling Thunder.
[*]Twelve events appear only in runs with the Koala or the Panda, such as The Last Dumpling, Eucalyptus Tollbooth, Dream Exchange and The Summit Picnic.
[*]Two enchantments come from these events: [b]Well-Rested[/b] (a Retained card gives Block) and [b]Freshly-Cut[/b] (a Panda card that Munches gives a short damage boost).
[/list]

[h2]Better with two[/h2]
In multiplayer runs, both characters start with [b]Hold Hands[/b]. Quarrel and Make Up are cards too, because that is how it goes. Besides Hold Hands, five more colorless cards can appear: [b]Share a Bite[/b], [b]Quarrel[/b], [b]Make Up[/b], [b]Assist[/b] and [b]Promise[/b]. The Koala has five co-op cards of its own and the Panda has seven, such as [b]Wake-Up Kiss[/b], [b]Pajama Party[/b], [b]Piggyback Charge[/b] and [b]Partner in Crime[/b]. Each character also has a co-op relic, three shared relics can drop, and several events need a second player. Co-op cards that give resources target one ally you choose. None of this shows up in singleplayer.

[h2]Memory Album: a scrapbook of your climbs[/h2]
A [b]Memory Album[/b] button on the main menu opens an achievement album with a hand-drawn photo for every memory: 56 achievements on seven pages. 45 can be earned in singleplayer; the other 11 need a co-op run with any teammate.
[list]
[*]Bronze, Silver and Gold achievements worth 1, 2 and 3 points, 109 in total. Counting ones show a progress bar, and three are hidden.
[*]A banner with the medal when you earn one, a red dot on the album button, and new entries that pop in when you open the album.
[*]The end-of-run screen shows what you earned that run and what is close.
[*]New album backgrounds and a menu pin at 20, 45, 70 and 109 points, and titles from Gold achievements.
[*]Keepsakes only: achievements never change cards, rewards, events or combat.
[/list]

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BaseLib[/b]. Steam asks you to subscribe to it as well.
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time, the game asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]For multiplayer, every player needs this mod on the same version.
[*]Do not also keep a manual copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder.
[*]Unlocks and achievements are saved in the mod's own progress file for each player, not in the game save.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves are not touched. On a fresh modded save, the mod still starts act 1 with Neow.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Tested on game version v0.107.1 only. Other versions may not load.

Source code and full README: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

Fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit. Card art, icons and character images made with AI image generation.
